Bookkeeping counters _tm_enq/dedup/capdrop/stale/datadrop/handoff, debug via AWECRAFT_TMDEBUG=1, worker times via AWECRAFT_TIMING=1 (BUILDCHUNK_T) + perf_build_worker_ms.

Why total_ms misses the 10% bar (diagnosed, not guessed). TMDEBUG/TGDEBUG event timelines show: (1) mesh workers are essentially idle — every TMESH ENQ shows inflight=1, i.e. the feed, not worker capacity, paces meshing; (2) wall time is set by the frame-budgeted drain (1–2 units per frame) plus the pre-existing AC-0082 threadgen re-pick churn — 2342 no-op gen re-picks in the ON arm (the drain re-picks the lowest-score empty-data entry every frame and consumes a budget unit even when the key is already in flight); (3) generation costs 31–42 ms/chunk and is fed at ~12/s by that same drain, so the 4.2 s of main-thread build cost removed by threading was mostly hidden behind gen-feeding wait. Result: big main-thread win (build_ms −96.5%, frame spikes 84→65 ms) but only a 6.6% wall-time win. The re-pick churn lives in _drain_build_queue's gen path (AC-0082 shared code) — fixing it is out of scope for AC-0107 (would change sync/web behavior); recorded as an open deviation for the coordinator. r50 skipped: the plan says "if cheap", and r50 runs are multi-minute each and cannot overturn the r4 verdict.

G5 — flake loop (threaded on)

First loop (before fix): player run 2/6 hung — but after printing the exact RESULT (hang at process exit); buckets runs not reached. OFF arm control: 4/4 clean → causality confirmed. gdb attach was blocked (ptrace_scope), so root-caused from behavior: a worker still executing a GDScript static call (ChunkScript.build_accs) while the engine unloads scripts at shutdown deadlocks (worker waits on script lock held by cleanup; cleanup waits for the pool). Mesh rebuilds keep dispatching tasks during the test (fluid ticks around the spawn), so a task is frequently in flight at quit.

Fix (in world._exit_tree, bounded 1 s): spin on is_task_completed for all in-flight threadgen+threadmesh tids before clearing bookkeeping — no worker is running when the engine unloads; the cap guarantees the exit can never hang because of this drain.

Honest deviations

  1. G4 total_ms FAIL (6.6% < 10%) — reported honestly. build_ms (the point of the task) passes at 96.5%. Root cause = pre-existing drain/gen pacing, not the threaded build. Fixing the drain re-pick churn is an AC-0082/shared-code follow-up, out of AC-0107 scope.
  2. Exit-drain fix in _exit_tree — not in the plan; added to pass G5 (real deadlock found during the flake loop). Minimal, bounded, threadmesh/threadgen bookkeeping only.
  3. Worker surface buffers are plain dicts, not Acc objects — Acc is a GDScript class instance; workers hand back {v,n,c,u,i,q} dicts and the main thread wraps them in Acc (_acc_from_dict). _qgrow/_qwrite/_qwrite_merged take an untyped acc shared by both paths — sync behavior identical (verified by G1/G2/G3 exact values).
  4. r50 A/B skipped — "if cheap" condition; r4 is the gate's decisive run and r50 cannot overturn its verdict (each r50 arm run is multi-minute).
